answer: The CEE Department offers one program, Civil Engineering, leading to BS, BE and MS degrees.

source_quote: The mission of the Civil & Environmental Engineering Department at Rafik Hariri
answer: Civil Engineering mission: high-quality undergraduate and graduate education, preparing students for civil engineering careers and research, lifelong learning, teamwork and ethical behavior. Graduates are expected to build successful careers, pursue graduate studies, lead teams, keep learning and serve their community.

source_quote: The Civil & Environmental Engineering Department adopts ABET Student Learning
answer: Civil Engineering adopts the seven ABET student outcomes: solve complex engineering problems; engineering design considering public health, safety and global factors; communicate effectively; ethical and professional judgment; teamwork; experimentation and data interpretation; and acquiring new knowledge.

source_quote: The Bachelor of Engineering program in Civil Engineering is accredited by the
answer: The Bachelor of Engineering in Civil Engineering is accredited by the Engineering Accreditation Commission of ABET under the General Criteria and the Program Criteria for Civil and Similarly Named Engineering Programs.

answer: Civil engineers can work in construction, infrastructure, transportation, consulting, water resources, environmental, government and public works sectors, and are prepared for entrepreneurial ventures.

source_quote: The Bachelor of Engineering (BE) program in Civil Engineering comprises 152 credit
answer: The BE in Civil Engineering is 152 credits over eight regular and three summer semesters; the BS is 118 credits over six regular and three summer semesters. Either degree requires a CGPA, major GPA and Summative Learning Project grade of 70 or above.

answer: BE in Civil Engineering (152 credits): General Education 30 (20%), College Requirements 27 (18%), Program Requirements 95 (62%); major 71 mandatory + 15 elective, non-major 56 mandatory + 10 elective.
